journal_lines: Smelled them before the tree line opened. Seven, maybe eight. Held the ground.
§oYellow eyes at the edge of the dark. We read each other. Neither side moved first.
Wild pack came out of the grass low and slow. Territorial display. Matched it. Both sides backed down eventually.
Their lead wolf had a torn ear and a lot of weight behind the eyes. We agreed on nothing. We agreed on that.
Stood until the wind shifted and carried our scent to them. That settled the question of whether to go further.
Six of them. Counted. The count did not change what needed doing, which was standing still.
§oThe standoff had a sound — low, continuous, coming from both sides. Lasted until it didn't.
Both packs moved on when the moment passed. No injuries. Territory question unresolved, as always.
